introText: Scan the code with your phone to start. Four quick drills on one phone, about three minutes. (No phone handy? Press ENTER to use the keyboard.)
finishText: That's the whole game: call a play in the huddle, then run it. Grab your friends and press PLAY on the title screen. Bots play every spot nobody takes.

steps.title: 1 of 4: THROW A PASS
steps.text: You're the quarterback. Tap HIKE on your phone. Then drag the throw stick toward a receiver and let go. A quick flick throws hard, a longer hold throws a soft lob. Complete one pass.

steps.title: 2 of 4: RUN WITH THE BALL
steps.text: Now you have the ball. Run with the stick and hold SPRINT to go faster. When a defender gets close, tap JUKE to dodge him. Get 10 yards.

steps.title: 3 of 4: MAKE A TACKLE
steps.text: Defense! A runner is coming at you. Run at him and tap TACKLE when you're close. Hitting him at full speed, or from behind, works best.

steps.title: 4 of 4: A REAL PLAY
steps.text: Everyone's on the field now, 11 on 11. You're the quarterback again: hike, then throw or run. If you're lost, tap FIND ME and your player lights up on the TV.
